simple.meaning: יֳפִי (yŏphîy) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “beauty.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 19 times across Esther, Psalms, Proverbs, Isaiah, Lamentations, and 2 more, beginning at Esther 1:11. Its contexts include family line, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יֳפִי (H3308).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: יֳפִי (yŏphîy) / H3308 is traced through Esther 1:11, Psalms 45:12, Psalms 50:2, Proverbs 6:25 as a generated source-based concept entry.

timeline.evidenceText: to bring Vashti the queen before the king with the royal crown, to show the people and the princes her beauty; for she was beautiful.
The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift.
Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty,
Don’t lust after her beauty in your heart,
Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain;
It shall happen that instead of sweet spices, there shall be rottenness;
Your eyes will see the king in his beauty.
All that pass by clap their hands at you.
Your renown went out among the nations for your beauty; for it was perfect, through my majesty which I had put on you,” says the Lord Yahweh.
“ ‘ “But you trusted in your beauty, and played the prostitute because of your renown, and poured out your prostitution on everyone who passed by. It was his.
You have built your lofty place at the head of every way, and have made your beauty an abomination, and have opened your feet to everyone who passed by, and multiplied your prostitution.
and tell Tyre, ‘You who dwell at the entry of the sea, who are the merchant of the peoples to many islands, the Lord Yahweh says:
Your borders are in the heart of the seas.
The men of Arvad with your army were on your walls all around,
therefore, behold, I will bring strangers on you,
“Son of man, take up a lamentation over the king of Tyre, and tell him, ‘The Lord Yahweh says:
Your heart was lifted up because of your beauty.
The cedars in the garden of God could not hide it.
For how great is his goodness,

definitions.full: H3308. yophi [ יֳפִי ] noun masculine beauty ; — absolute יֹ֫פִי Isa 3:24 5 t.; construct יְפִי Ezek 28:7 ; suffix יָפְיִ֑ךָ 28:17 ; יָפְיֵךָ Psa 45:12 5 t.; יָפְיוֺ Isa 33:17 2 t.; יָפְיָהּ Prov 6:25 ; Est 1:11 ; beauty of a woman Isa 3:24 ; Psa 45:12 ; Est 1:11 ; Prov 6:25 , compare 31:30 ; of Jerusalem under figure of woman Ezek 16:14-15 , 25 ; Tyre 27:3 ( יֹ֑פִי כְּלִי֫לַת ), compare 27:4 ; 27:11 ; prince of Tyre, beauty of (his) wisdom 28:7 ; king of Tyre 28:12 ( יפי כְּלִיל ), 28:17 ; ideal beauty of king of Judah Isa 33:17 , Zion ( מִכְלַליֹֿ֑פִי ) Psa 50:2 , compare Lam 2:15 ( יֹ֑פִי כְּלִי֫לַת ); of Egypt under figure of tree Ezek 31:8 ; of ransomed people of ׳י Zech 9:17 .
